**Downloads:** pick the archive for your system below, unpack it and put `tapespeed` on your `PATH`.
tapespeed needs [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) installed. On Windows, use the Linux build inside WSL.
Check the download against `SHA256SUMS` (`shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing`).

**macOS:** the binaries are not signed by Apple, so Gatekeeper blocks them on first start — right-click
→ *Open* in Finder, or run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine tapespeed` once.

New here? Start with the [user guide](https://github.com/dg1yfe/tapespeed/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
